source_variables.tmp: monthly average daily mean temperature, degC

annual_variables.vpd: calendar-day-weighted annual mean of monthly derived VPD, hPa

vpd.monthly_formula: VPD = SVP - AVP; AVP = CRU vap; SVP = 6.1078*exp(a*T/(T+b)) hPa
vpd.reference: Zhong Z, Chen HW, Dai A et al. (2025), Nature Communications 16, 8247
vpd.caveat: SVP is nonlinear in temperature. Calculating VPD from monthly-mean temperature omits sub-daily/diurnal temperature variability and can differ from an average of VPD calculated at sub-daily resolution. Use as long-term climate context rather than high-frequency atmospheric dryness.

cru_reference: Harris I, Osborn TJ, Jones P and Lister D (2020), Scientific Data 7, 109
